offering_description.value: Provides credit information, risk analytics, fraud prevention and financial marketing to businesses and government agencies worldwide. It also provides workforce verification and HR services to employers and agencies, and credit monitoring and identity protection to consumers. It combines data and analytics on cloud platforms to deliver these offerings.

quotes.quote: Equifax serves consumers and business customers through three business units. Each business unit focuses on the needs of unique market segments, putting customers first in everything they do. They are each aligned to our strategic priorities — accelerating innovation and driving new products and services built on the Equifax Cloud ™.

Only Equifax has a powerful combination of differentiated data, advanced analytics, a cloud-native data fabric and scalable global platforms. Equifax brings unrivaled decision intelligence to a wide spectrum of global customers in industries ranging from lending and fraud detection and prevention to HR management, marketing and more.
